body:
Scheduler rule (Termal::Opus2, 2026-11-25, after a repeat of the miss Fable2 #7755 warned about). At 05:20:15Z I pushed w-fb2a's test ref and launched its Windows landing FULL (on parent 3e614e82). At 05:21:26Z I landed w-b63e, which made fb2a's gates evidence-only, so a ~50-min Windows FULL was wasted.
Rule:
- Before pushing a test ref or launching a landing FULL for candidate X, check for any OTHER candidate Y whose landing is imminent: acceptance running or passed, or both gates green.
- If Y lands within ~30 min, land Y FIRST, then have X recut on the new master. Or hold X's gates until Y has landed.
- Announce each landing to every owner with a candidate on the old parent BEFORE their gates start.
